description: This file contains type definitions, utility functions, and imports related to Next.js server-side rendering, including context types, component types, API request/response types, and helper functions for URL formatting and initial props loading.

methods.name: execOnce
methods.description: Wraps a function to ensure it is only executed once, caching the result for subsequent calls.

methods.name: getLocationOrigin
methods.description: Returns the origin URL (protocol + hostname + port) based on window.location.

methods.name: getURL
methods.description: Returns the current URL path excluding the origin.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name of a React component or string.

methods.name: isResSent
methods.description: Checks if the server response has been finished or headers sent.

methods.name: loadGetInitialProps
methods.description: Loads initial properties for a Next.js component, handling various edge cases and environment checks.

methods.name: formatWithValidation
methods.description: Formats a URL object into a string, with validation warnings in development mode.
